notes.title: Update 1.1 is finally here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087301/60a62dfb6045f3ac34c4ed3f25b799a0c653f24e.png[/img]

Hello there, fellow prehistoric chefs! 

Exciting news - [b]Manitas Kitchen[/b]'s first major update is coming to Steam just a week before it launches on all consoles, isn't that thrilling?

Since launch, we've been hard at work, actively listening to the community and hunting down those elusive bugs that crept into the game. We'll dive into the patch notes shortly!

The highlight of this update is undoubtedly the introduction of [b]a new Game Mode[/b] alongside Story Mode; the [b]Let Them Cook Mode! [/b]Have you ever dreamed of playing in an endless mode with everything you've unlocked so far in Story Mode? Well, you're in luck, because that's exactly what we're bringing to the table!

Moreover, if you show enough prowess in this new mode, you'll unlock a little surprise for Trexito!

Now, let's go through those Patch Notes!

[list]
[*] We've made countless adjustments to the game's pacing, improving timings and halving the duration of event intervals in the story. This means fewer "dead days" waiting for something to happen!
[*] Fixed texts that remained in English when the player was playing in another language, as well as grammatical errors.
[*] Fixed a strange bug that caused certain dialogues to be repeated during night turns.
[*] Fixed an issue with the "Pangea" pizza ingredients – mushrooms were meant to be black olives.
[*] Corrected various sprites during some conversation scenes.
[*] Adjustments to the volume of background music in pause menus.
[*] Fixed visual glitches in the shop, where money was duplicated.
[*] Fixed Marsh and Collini's abilities, which sometimes did not work correctly.
[*] Fixed Marsh's position when baking pizza. No more seeing a Triceratops going through the floor!
[*] Fixed a random bug with Trexito; when Trexito used his special ability on a pizza with a sauce that didn't match the first order, Trexito wouldn't place the ingredients, and the ability would go into cooldown.
[*] Added new music tracks!
[*] Fixed a visual error related to the sauce bottles that occurred after unlocking the four cheese pizza; they would stop appearing in orders.
[*] Fixed the texture and position of Collini's sauce bottle in the kitchen.
[*] Fixed a strange bug that made the appearance of sabotages random; some players saw sabotages normally, while others didn't see any throughout their gameplay.
[*] Improved the textures of Alpizzino and Pangea pizzas. They're more appetizing now.
[/list]

And... that's everything! Thanks so much for reading and playing [b]Manitas Kitchen[/b], and we'll see you soon!

Don't forget to follow us on our social networks (we are, literally, everywhere) and remember that we have super nice merchandising for sale at the Entalto Store, click bellow! 

[url=https://www.entaltostudios.com/category/manitas-kitchen-collection][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087301/ec8668ba616594cde827f882734170ffd0053fcb.png[/img][/url]

[b][url=https://twitter.com/ManitasKitchen]Little Arrow Games[/url] & [url=https://twitter.com/EntaltoStudios]Entalto Publishing[/url][/b]

notes.title: Manitas Kitchen Hotfix 1.01
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone! [/b]

First of all from Entalto Publishing and Little Arrow Games we want to thank you all for the immense love you have given to the game in its launch weekend, you are all really amazing! 

We've been reading you all very carefully, and we also want to thank you very much for bringing bugs to our attention, so today we bring you the first Manitas Kitchen hotfix, which fixes several minor things! 

[list]
[*] The game no longer starts by default in Spanish, now it starts by default in English unless you have the computer in Spanish.
[*] The "When do I get to sleep?" achievement has been fixed. It will now appear correctly when it should. 
[*] Achievements now no longer pop when closing the application, but in real time, much more satisfying! 
[*] Also, we have removed the Unity splash screen, to make the startup even faster and prettier.
[/list]
We are still working day and night to fix more problems detected by you, our wonderful community, we ask for your time and thank you again for being so wonderful! 

See you in the next update! 

Entalto Publishing & Little Arrow Games
